paper.core_task: Benchmarking multimodal large language models on low-level visual perception and understanding

contributions.name: A benchmark for low-level visual perception of MLLMs
contributions.author_claim_text: We build a benchmark for MLLMs on low-level perception ability. To achieve this, we construct a first-of-its-kind balanced and comprehensive LLVisionQA dataset with 2,990 images with one low-level-related question-answer pair for each image.
contributions.description: The authors construct the LLVisionQA dataset with 2,990 images and question-answer pairs to evaluate the low-level perception ability of MLLMs, covering diverse sources and question types.

contributions.name: A benchmark process for low-level description evaluation
contributions.author_claim_text: We define a benchmark process to evaluate the low-level description ability of MLLMs, including an LLDescription dataset of 499 images with expert-labelled long golden quality descriptions, and a GPT-assisted evaluation to rate MLLM-descriptions in terms of completeness, preciseness, and relevance.
contributions.description: The authors propose a benchmark with the LLDescription dataset and a GPT-assisted evaluation process to assess MLLMs' ability to describe low-level visual information.

contributions.name: A unified softmax-based quality prediction strategy
contributions.author_claim_text: To evaluate precise quality assessment ability, we propose a unified softmax-based quality prediction strategy for all MLLMs based on their probability outputs.
contributions.description: The authors introduce a softmax-based method to extract quantifiable quality scores from MLLMs by pooling logits of 'good' and 'poor' tokens, bridging MLLMs with traditional IQA tasks.
